ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector $MN$ of $AB$ intersects $AC$ at point $D$, and $BD$ is drawn. If $AC=9$ and $BC=5$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle BDC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the perpendicular bisector $MN$ of $AB$ intersects $AC$ at point D,\\
it follows that $AD=BD$,\\
Since $AC=9$ and $BC=5$,\\
the perimeter of $\triangle BDC$ is $BD+CD+BC=AD+CD+BC=AC+BC=9+5=\boxed{14}$.
